name: Employee My Requests shows an empty state with a New Request call to action

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'fresh.employee@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'My Requests' page via the sidebar link (URL /requests).

Verify the empty state is shown: the page contains the text 'You haven't submitted any requests yet' and the description 'Your submitted requests will appear here', and a 'New request' button is visible.
